web-guide-idea-113.audience: People curious about an Indian’s everyday life overseas.
web-guide-idea-113.offer: Share personal routines such as cooking familiar food or comparing grocery habits. Present your own experience rather than broad claims about a whole country.
web-guide-idea-113.steps.1: Show your own routine in a permitted, privacy-conscious setting.
web-guide-idea-113.steps.2: Explain a cultural difference and invite questions.
web-guide-idea-113.equipment: A phone and reliable connection. Use a home setup when shop filming is not permitted.
web-guide-idea-113.returnReason: Alternate food, household habits and seasonal experiences so the diary keeps developing.
web-guide-idea-113.promotion: Preview one specific comparison and say where your personal experience comes from.
web-guide-idea-113.metadataTitle: My Indian Life Abroad — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · Saathum
web-guide-idea-113.metadataDescription: Share cooking, groceries and everyday cultural differences from your life outside India. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
